position_overview: Virtual Calling all truly AWESOME people! About Stranger Soccer Stranger Soccer ( www.strangersoccer.com) is a Singapore-based company experiencing explosive growth. In a few short years, after launching a revolutionaryplatform and Mobile App for on-demand football, the company has amassed over 50,000 registeredusers playing hundreds of games a week. It has solved the problem that football is the world's #1sport, but is difficult for an individual to play. Stranger Soccer makes it as easy as going to the gym orfor a jog.Browse. Book a slot. Show up and play. Today, it is the #1 way people play football and futsal inSingapore, and is rapidly expanding internationally via a license partner model with locations in Australia, India, USA, UAE, and SouthAfrica, and growing fast. Role The selected candidate(s) will work closely with the CEO, Executive Director, as well as a small global team. He or she will have overall ownership of supporting the license support process, including: Overseeing the lead generation process and channels, ensuring the targeted number of leads come in Maintaining and updating the license pipeline, ensuring timely follow-up, setting appointments, and reporting. Manage other ad hoc projects and workstreams as directed Requirements Experience in international B2B & B2C sales: lead generation and pipeline management Experience in international license or FRANCHISE DEVELOPMENT Experience in other project management and administrative work Excellent English communication skills Strong attention to detail and passion for customer service Positive attitude and team player Bachelor's Degree/Diploma Interest in football is a BIG PLUS Experience working overseas or with international companies a PLUS Hospitality experience a PLUS Familiarity with LinkedIn, Notion, and/or Slack a PLUS Experience supervising others a PLUS (if and as the team grows) Other Details Position will be virtual (e.g., based in Philippines) with occasional travel to Singapore. To apply, please send resume to recruitment@strangersoccer.com . Please include cover note and salary expectations. Benefits Other Details Position will be virtual (e.g., based in Philippines) with occasional travel to Singapore. To apply, please send resume to recruitment@strangersoccer.com . Please include cover note and salary expectations. Originally posted on Himalayas
